about_the_game:
NOTE: Requires POWDER RUNNERS: MAZE QUEST

This DLC unlocks a game mode in the base game.

DLC: Time Race

The maze remains the same, but now every second counts. When you complete a game, your time is recorded—and on your next attempt, you'll have the chance to beat it. Challenge yourself and see how quickly you can reach the center!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.

short_description: Surpass your own limits and break your record in the maze!
